Problem Statement:
Convert a given infix expression into postfix notation using Stack.
Input Description:
The code should take a string of arbitrary length (infix notation). 
Output Description:
Print the corresponding form of postfix notation. 
Sample Input:
A+B*C+D 
Sample Output:
ABC*+D+ 
Explanation:
The equivalent postfix notation of ABC*+D+
